materialUpdate.observation: Fresh reporting dated 15 September attributes to Knights coach Justin Holbrook that Dylan Lucas will be named in Newcastle's Tuesday 22-man squad. Holbrook also states that whether Lucas reaches the field remains uncertain and multiple steps remain before he can play.
materialUpdate.source: Fox Sports Australia, 15 September 2026 10:36 AEST, quoting Justin Holbrook on The Agenda Setters
materialUpdate.conflict: Conflicts with the current NRL Casualty Ward listing of ankle / 2027. The casualty listing is not deleted; the newer direct coach selection-intent statement requires the Week 2 state to remain unresolved until the official Tuesday team list and subsequent fitness evidence.
materialUpdate.decisionEffect: Do not treat Lucas as definitively unavailable for Week 2. Do not treat him as available either. If named, classify as roster presence plus low-sample/return-from-injury uncertainty until confirmed to play. No directional performance uplift is assigned.

otherSignals.Sam Walker: Secondary report says he was sighted running at training and Trent Robinson said never say never. Remains return signal only, not verified Week 2 availability.
otherSignals.Angus Crichton: Robinson remained uncertain; no promotion to verified availability.
otherSignals.Jackson Ford: Secondary reporting describes long odds for Week 2 pending scans; not official exclusion.
otherSignals.Leka Halasima: Secondary reporting expects absence pending scans; not official Week 2 team-list exclusion.
otherSignals.Dallin Watene-Zelezniak: Secondary reporting expects return; official Week 2 roster not yet captured.
